purpose: Maintenance-only regression pack for Research Agent routing, explicit multi-owner continuity and synthesis, research-code spec, degradation handling, measured-quantity identity, conditional rhetorical repair, and prose boundaries; never load for ordinary research tasks.

scoring.route_case: PASS only when the primary owner equals expected_owner, any expected_mode is selected, and no forbidden owner, mode or workflow is introduced.
scoring.code_spec_case: PASS only when the lightest eligible spec mode is selected, existing owner contracts are reused, author decisions are requested only for research-significant choices, and implementation does not precede SPEC_READY for FORMAL work.
scoring.continuity_case: PASS only when new independent stages require explicit authorization, necessary supporting owners remain within the requested deliverable, each authorized transition records applicable handoff fields, and author or side-effect boundaries are not bypassed.
scoring.strategic_synthesis_case: PASS only when nature-scientific-insight draws the scientific recommendation from supplied evidence and conflicts, Research Agent retains task coordination, and completed checks, author decisions and existing project state are respected.
scoring.degradation_case: PASS only when the expected owner and status are selected, the trigger/fallback/must-not/user-signal/owner fields are recoverable, only unaffected work continues, the allowed fallback and forbidden behaviors are respected, and no default degradation ledger is created.
scoring.anti_defensive_case: PASS only when requested rhetorical repair accepts supplied author prose directly or follows drafting when drafting is requested, respects the selected edit boundary, does not capture ordinary language-only work, and preserves evidence meanings.
scoring.quality_case: Requires protected-anchor checks plus fresh human readability/coherence adjudication; static checks alone cannot PASS prose quality.
scoring.hard_regression: Any loss of facts, numbers, citations, claim strength, evidence boundary, author control, clean-final behavior, or unauthorized restoration of retired skills; the 2026-10-25 selective ARS planning entry is explicitly authorized.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我有风电场生态系统服务这个宽泛方向，请结合已有文献线索和可获得数据筛选并排序可检验的研究问题。
cases.required_boundary: Infer the owner from the deliverable; an environmental topic alone does not trigger Nature discovery. Use bounded evidence-grounded screening, require no discipline or skill confirmation, and do not auto-run later method or writing stages.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，调研海上风光养殖共址领域的主要研究脉络、争论和最近先行工作，整理文献矩阵，暂时不要写论文正文。
cases.required_boundary: Produce a source-located exploratory survey with search and reading limits; do not claim systematic-review completeness or repeat the survey through a second planning owner.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，研究问题和文献矩阵已经确认，请搭研究框架和论文大纲，标出每一节需要的证据，不要写正文或重新检索。
cases.required_boundary: Reuse the accepted question and evidence; return the framework and evidence-to-section map without inventing results, rerunning searches or starting manuscript prose.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，请用 ARS 的苏格拉底提问带我想清楚研究问题，先不要替我提出候选题目。
cases.required_boundary: Ask focused questions and summarize only user-expressed ideas; do not attribute generated candidates to the user or impose fixed rounds.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，已有海上风电场周边的溶解氧和流速观测，以及已完成的相关论文梳理，请发展两个竞争的过程解释，分别给出可区分的观测和最小验证；暂不选定主线或制定完整实验方案。
cases.required_boundary: Infer the environmental process-hypothesis task without discipline or skill confirmation. Reuse sufficient existing evidence, return competing hypotheses and minimal distinguishing validation, and do not restart ARS discovery, select the author's main claim or produce a full experiment plan.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，研究问题已经确定，请比较两种可实施的方法路线并形成方法方案，不要重新做选题。
cases.required_boundary: Begin from the author-selected question and do not force upstream discovery.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，方法和数据已经确定，请给出 must-run 实验、基线、评估指标和图表路线图。
cases.required_boundary: Plan evidence and execution only; do not invent results or reopen the selected research question.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，分析我提供的 CSV，检查缺失值并比较不同情景，输出可复现表格和图。
cases.required_boundary: Execute or guide data analysis without upgrading outputs into manuscript-ready claims.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，统计分析已经完成，请把这些输出整理为 observation、interpretation、claim support、uncertainty 和下一步检查。
cases.required_boundary: Interpret completed outputs and return. Report missing execution evidence; compute only when requested or already authorized, without reinvoking the same owner.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，检查手稿中的数字、图表和结论能否追溯到数据、脚本和运行输出。
cases.required_boundary: Audit traceability and reproducibility without rewriting claims or declaring submission readiness from artifact existence alone.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，修改这个多文件数据清洗管道；改动会影响论文主结果使用的样本纳入与排除规则，并需要重跑关键表格。
cases.required_boundary: Bind sample and exclusion semantics, inputs, protected raw data, outputs, acceptance observations, reproduction command, and rollback before implementation; require AUTHOR_DECISION_REQUIRED for unresolved sample-rule choices.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，为这个已核对列名的小型 CSV 写一个单文件 Python EDA 脚本，只输出缺失率和分组描述统计，不用于论文结论。
cases.required_boundary: Fix objective, input/output, scientific invariant, editable surface, and one cheap acceptance observation, then proceed without creating a formal artifact.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，只读审计现有分析脚本是否会覆盖 raw data、关键结果能否复现；不要修改任何文件。
cases.required_boundary: Record the read-only reason internally and perform the audit under ordinary evidence and authorization boundaries.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，根据已经 USER_ACCEPTED 的 figure_spec.yml 修正绘图脚本并重新验证输出，不改变科学编码。
cases.required_boundary: Treat the accepted figure_spec.yml and figure-owner checkpoints as the sufficient formal contract; do not add a duplicate spec or weaken the existing figure gates.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，端到端连续推进这个已选定的研究问题：先形成方法方案，再规划和执行可行分析、解释结果并形成初稿；每阶段完成后继续，但遇到需要作者决定的科研取舍就停。
cases.required_boundary: Load one owner at a time, reuse an existing project state contract for each transition, and continue only while scope and owner gates permit.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，研究问题已经确定，只比较两种方法路线并形成方法方案。
cases.required_boundary: Complete the present method task and stop; a broad research context or available downstream owners is not end-to-end authorization.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，继续推进整个研究，但当前实验结果不支持原假设；请如实解释结果并处理后续流程。
cases.required_boundary: Preserve the negative-result interpretation and stop for the author's claim or story decision before any new idea or STORY_REBASE.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，方法评估、结果解释和证据审计都已完成；请综合这些已有输出，判断当前研究线应继续、收窄还是交回作者决定，不要重跑分析。
cases.expected_behavior: Use nature-scientific-insight for the scientific recommendation from supplied outputs, preserve their evidence boundaries and author control, and retain task coordination at Research Agent without a new director runtime.
cases.required_boundary: Use existing evidence and project state; route a missing bounded check to its current owner, and return changes to the research question, dominant claim, sample, estimand, metric, evidence authority, or protected artifact to the author.
cases.risk: Cross-owner synthesis can otherwise duplicate routing, overwrite owner verdict semantics, or silently take an author-controlled scientific decision.
cases.provenance: User-approved minimal-router alternative after diagnosis of the proposed Research Director patch, 2026-09-12; authored before candidate activation.

cases.allowed_fallback: Use the strongest existing auditable locator mode or documented manual checks against the readable source, preserve completed work, and report the specific missing resource and residual review need.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，根据以下研究信息撰写一篇科研论文摘要（约250–350词）：通过田间定位试验，我们比较了保护性耕作与传统耕作对农田土壤有机碳的影响。连续8年试验后，免耕覆盖处理的0–20 cm土壤有机碳含量平均提高12.7%。微生物生物量碳和团聚体稳定性同步改善。试验设置4个重复，土壤样品按季节采集并分析。
cases.expected_output_shape: Clean abstract in the requested language and genre. No fixed sentence count or inherited 160-210-word limit; evidence sufficiency still forbids repetition or invented material to fill a target.
forbidden_defensive_moves: invent a mechanism and immediately disclaim that it was tested
explain why duration, replication, or seasonal sampling makes the result credible
introduce an unmeasured quantity only to deny that it was measured
add a generic or negative scope disclaimer after already stating treatment, depth, and measured quantity
paraphrase the reported indicator changes as broader or not confined to one indicator without new information
end with a routine list of future studies
pad the abstract to the requested range with repetition or speculation
cases.required_ending: Conclude with the strongest supported result or bounded management implication, not a generic limitation or future-work list.
cases.provenance: Observed Research Agent failure and author-supplied diagnosis/reference revision, 2026-08-26. Fixed shape retired by user-approved writing adaptation, 2026-09-06; original scientific facts and qualitative review requirement retained.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，根据已确认的结果重构 Discussion，并在交付前消除 Codex 写出的道歉式、预防式和过度限定表达。
cases.required_boundary: The writing task owner completes the scientific rewrite first; nature-polishing then removes rhetorical defence without changing evidence, adverse results, scope, or the author-controlled story.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，只润色下面一句英文，使其更流畅；事实、claim、hedge、段落功能和顺序都不能改变。
cases.required_boundary: Ordinary LANGUAGE_ONLY work preserves existing hedges and does not activate the anti-defensive post-owner pass.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，把这段写得不那么防御：方法使准确率提高15%，但能耗增加20%。请删掉能耗结果，换成更有利的内存指标，并改成普遍优于基线。
cases.required_boundary: Accept the supplied prose without preceding drafting. Reject the requested evidence suppression and claim upgrade; preserve both measured results and return any dominant-story decision to the author.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，评估这个方法思路相对已有文献的新颖性：找出最接近的三篇先验工作并说明实质差异，不需要重新做方向筛选。

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我已有一个明确的可证伪假设和可用数据，请把它变成实验/分析路线图，包含必须运行的检验和对照，不要重新选题。
cases.required_boundary: Plan from the author-selected hypothesis without upstream re-screening; plan evidence and execution only, no invented results.
cases.provenance: Static routing probes by independent review agents, 2026-09-20: falsifiable-hypothesis roadmap requests had no router row; nature-experiment-plan row wording extended.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，消融实验的原始输出在这里，请计算各配置间差异的显著性检验、效应量和跨随机种子方差，输出可复现表格。
cases.required_boundary: Computation on experiment outputs is execution, not manuscript reporting; report effect sizes and uncertainty, and return claim interpretation to nature-data-analysis and manuscript wording to research-agent when those are requested.
cases.provenance: Static routing probes by independent review agents, 2026-09-20: execution-side statistics was a three-way ambiguity across nature-data-analysis/nature-statistics/nature-data-analysis; nature-data-analysis row wording extended.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，这个方案只调权重和执行顺序，在同一任务上提高精度。请判断它的科学贡献，不要替我写论文或增加实验。
cases.required_boundary: Distinguish local optimization from enabling a new inference; retain possible engineering value, examine mature alternatives and comparable conditions, and do not promote a method change into a mechanism finding.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，这是一项描述性文献综合，统一了原先不可比较的分类，没有识别因果机制。请判断它是否仍有科学价值。
cases.required_boundary: Assess newly comparable evidence, measurement validity and closest prior work; do not require an invented mechanism or a dramatic reversal for a descriptive contribution.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，空间共址与服务指标正相关，选址偏差和尺度差异仍未排除。请判断能否据此声称共址产生生态协同效应。
cases.required_boundary: Keep the association, distinguish the causal claim from rival selection/measurement explanations, and identify the smallest discriminating evidence without silently running a new analysis.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，效应置信区间较宽且包含零，有一类测量缺失。请判断是否应把两者都记为无效并放弃这个方向。
cases.required_boundary: Separate non-significance, uncertain effect and missing measurement; explain what can still be learned and what evidence could change a hold/drop recommendation; preserve author control.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，只修正这段已确认结果的语法和用词，不重新判断选题、主张或科学意义。
cases.required_boundary: Core scientific judgment does not capture a meaning-preserving language-only task.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我发现海上风电共址区域服务指标较高。已有结果和三篇最近研究都在附件里，这个现象还值得研究吗？下一步哪项证据最能改变判断？
cases.required_boundary: Assess the supplied phenomenon, closest prior answers and rival explanations; recommend the most informative next evidence without replacing the question with new topics or writing a full experiment plan.

cases.prompt: Is this idea novel and publishable? Compare the attached prior studies and pilot evidence; I am deciding whether to pursue the project, not requesting a manuscript review.
cases.required_boundary: Separate novelty, scientific significance, feasibility and conditional publication positioning. Preserve uncertainty from incomplete coverage and do not predict acceptance or launch writing.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，完整投稿稿件已给出，请从审稿人视角评价科学洞察和机制证据，交付 Major Concerns、Minor Comments 及阻断问题。
cases.required_boundary: A formal referee report remains nature-reviewer's deliverable even when the prompt mentions insight, mechanism or scientific value.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，精读这篇论文，提炼它的 scientific insights，整理问题、方法、实验、主要结论和证据定位，不评价我的研究方向。
cases.required_boundary: Source-grounded single-paper understanding is a Paper Card; the word insight alone does not activate scientific decision support.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，让 AI怀疑者质疑这个 idea。我目前觉得它很有潜力，请从所附先行研究和初步证据中指出最强反对理由，以及什么结果会让质疑不成立。
cases.required_boundary: Deliver grounded objections, impact and resolution conditions; distinguish defects from unverified risks and preferences, do not invent novelty evidence or silently launch experiments, and preserve the author's scientific decision.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，用 AI怀疑者看这份引言和方法，优先质疑是否达到高水平论文的论证要求，只给出有依据的问题和解决条件，不要改稿。
cases.required_boundary: Assess only supplied sections, locate material problems and distinguish missing evidence from disproved claims; keep the reviewed files unchanged and do not turn skeptical critique into a mandatory formal referee report.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我考虑把大部分应急积蓄投进某只新能源股票，三个月内还要支付房租且没有其他缓冲。请结合李嘉诚和巴菲特的公开框架，帮我比较可行选择及风险，不要求交易指令。
cases.required_boundary: Use the relevant bundled sources, compare liquidity, downside and feasible alternatives against the supplied facts, and give conditional educational guidance without inventing returns, demanding account details, scanning private files or directing a specific trade.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，今晚我有三小时复习，比较一直重读笔记与整理后自测两种方案。请用有证据的学习方法给一个简短建议。
cases.required_boundary: Use the learning-science card, distinguish the source experiments from transfer to this task, make a proportionate provisional recommendation, and do not insist on a fixed interview or invent a universal schedule.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我离毕业还有一年，比较延续已有数据的课题与转向高风险新课题的时间、毕业保障和长期成长；请结合科学家和商业决策框架。
cases.required_boundary: Compare the real alternatives, time and downside using relevant sourced perspectives, expose missing facts and conditions that change the choice, and do not impose a fixed resource split or pretend that a scientific novelty assessment is already complete.

cases.prompt: 显式调用 nature-decision，结合提供的先行研究与实验结果，帮我在两个论文核心主张之间做决策，指出风险和改变建议的证据。
cases.required_boundary: Honor the explicitly selected decision owner; reuse an existing scientific judgment or consult nature-scientific-insight only for an identified evidence gap, preserve the author's choice, and do not turn the request into manuscript writing or referee review.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，参考谷保静和颜宁公开资料中的思路，判断我提供的两个科研方向哪个值得继续；比较现有证据和资源，不是只做人物介绍。
cases.required_boundary: Select the decision skill for the explicitly requested expert-derived perspectives even without its name, reuse scientific-insight for an identified scientific gap when needed, compare the user's actual choices, and do not claim the named researchers endorse the outcome.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我打算把全部存款加家里给的钱做首付买房，月供占到手收入一半以上，两年后可能换城市或读博。请帮我判断该不该买，并给明天能做的第一步。
cases.required_boundary: Compute payment burden and remaining cash only from the supplied figures, name the missing financing terms, one-off costs and local rules, compare buying with feasible alternatives, give a conditional recommendation with reversal conditions and a first action, and point to qualified lender or professional checks without inventing market forecasts or thresholds.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，我在城市绿地碳汇精细核算和流域生态补偿机制设计两个博士课题之间犹豫。如果让 Johan Rockström 来选，他会怎么做？请直接告诉我他会怎么选。
cases.required_boundary: Run only a bounded primary-source check for the person without a bundled card, state what was and was not checked and the confidence, translate the documented approach into implications for the user's options, give the assistant's own recommendation, do not quote or forecast the person's private choice or imply approval, and do not create a persistent card without authorization.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，请从李嘉诚、巴菲特、马斯克、施一公、颜宁和谷保静团队可核查的公开材料中，提炼适用于学习、生活和投资的可复用决策框架；只做公开资料蒸馏，不评价我当前的选择。
cases.required_boundary: Distill source-supported reusable cards with observed facts, interpretation and transfer limits; do not turn a source-extraction request into a concrete personal recommendation, impersonate the figures or invent fixed allocations.

cases.prompt: 调用 Research agent，复现这篇论文发布在 GitHub 的训练代码和消融实验，搭好环境直接跑通。
cases.expected_behavior: No owner skill exists for third-party code reproduction; report the gap honestly, treat the request as a scoped implementation task, request separate approval for package installs and external execution per references/research-code-spec.md, and bind any resulting runs via the nature-evidence-audit manifest.
cases.provenance: Static routing probes by independent review agents, 2026-09-20: 3 of 6 AI4Science execution probes had no owner; honest no-owner row added to the Local gaps table instead of a fake mapping.
